source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: Schedule M line 34 Social Security Benefits, 100% at or under the AGI limit and 65% above it for 2025 (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.17; Tax Division Social Security Modification page); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Married filing jointly, 63 and 64, federal AGI exactly 100,000: the 65% applies only when AGI 'exceeds' 100,000, so line 34 is still 100%. You (Column A) born 1962-02-02, age 63 at December 31, 2025; Spouse (Column B) born 1961-11-11, age 64 at December 31, 2025. Federal taxable Social Security (IRS worksheet, given): other income 74,500.00 + half of benefits 15,000.00 = provisional income 89,500.00; 85% x (89,500.00 - 44,000.00) = 38,675.00 + lesser of 6,000.00 and half the benefits 15,000.00 = 44,675.00, limited to 85% of benefits 25,500.00: 25,500.00. Federal AGI (given) = wages 74,500.00 (you) + taxable Social Security 25,500.00 = 100,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 100,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 68,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 100,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M You (Column A): line 47: age 63, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 0.00. Schedule M Spouse (Column B): line 34(a) total benefits 30,000.00, (b) exempt for federal 4,500.00, (c) taxable 25,500.00; federal AGI 100,000.00 does not exceed 100,000.00, so line 34 = 25,500.00 (100%); line 47: age 64, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 25,500.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 0.00 + 25,500.00 = 25,500.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 25,500.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 100,000.00 + 0.00 - 25,500.00 = 74,500.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 2 x 2,000.00 = 4,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 74,500.00 - 4,000.00 = 70,500.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 15,000.00 = 499.5 + 4.44% x 20,000.00 = 888 + 4.82% x 10,500.00 = 506.1; total 2559.6 = 2,559.60. The Tax Table row 70,500 to under 70,550 (PDF p.38 on) gives 2,561; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 2,559.60.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
